stages.headline: For a rational expression, divide the numerator and denominator by the highest power of n.
stages.headlineEnglish: For a rational expression, divide the numerator and denominator by the highest power of n.

stages.headline: If the numerator has lower degree the limit is 0; for equal degrees it is the ratio of the leading coefficients.

stages.headline: Multiply a difference of roots by its conjugate: √(n + 1) − √n = 1/(√(n + 1) + √n) → 0.

stages.headline: Find lim (√(n² + n) − n).
stages.solutionSteps: 1. Conjugate: n/(√(n² + n) + n). 2. Divide by n: 1/2.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. Conjugate: n/(√(n² + n) + n). 2. Divide by n: 1/2.
